tables: Benchmark | What it evaluates | Acceptance target | Scoring | Limit
WebArena‑Verified | Self-hosted interactive websites | Final JSON plus required network side effects | Programmatic; no LLM judge | Heavy deployment; strongest fit for browser A/B testing
Mind2Web | Offline webpage snapshots | Target element and action at each step | Programmatic action metrics | Evaluates process imitation
Online‑Mind2Web | 136 live websites | Action history and final completion | WebJudge plus human labels | Drift, CAPTCHA, and judge bias
WebVoyager | Visual interaction with live websites | Final answer and execution evidence | Multimodal LLM plus human verification | Weaker exact reproducibility
Mind2Web 2 | Long-horizon multi-site search | Research answer with citations | Rubric Agent-as-a-Judge | Not the first choice for UI browser cores
BU Bench V1 | 100 mixed tasks | Final outcomes and trajectories | Google judge LLM | Cloud-browser conditions affect comparability
Odysseys | 200 long-horizon multi-site tasks | Rubric completion | Model grading | High cost

NetworkEventEvaluator | HAR from this browser attempt | Match URL, method, status code, and, when declared, query, POST, response-field, or cookie conditions in network events. | Navigation or state changes produced the specified observable side effect. | It does not require a fixed click sequence; undeclared page state is outside the acceptance scope.
